description: Build an editable .mcpx source into a texture or re-serialize the source, with an optional batch applied after parsing. Returns PNG bytes and/or the built source via explicit output paths or embedded artifacts; no force, mkdir, or in-place writes.

outputMcpxPath.description: Explicit .mcpx output path. When omitted, the .mcpx text is embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

outputPngPath.description: Explicit PNG output path. When omitted, the PNG bytes are embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

name: build_asset
